name: Iuchi Nergüi
concept: Nergüi's Rokugani catches on certain words and he knows it, so he speaks slowly in order to speak clearly and reduce the extremity of Ujik inflection.

answers.stand_out: When Nergüi read the Kitsuki's fortune before accepting her service, the cards showed him a debt she would collect, and he accepted anyway.

answers.social_giri: Nergüi reads the cards for Nagiko's investigations even when the revelations yield nightmares.

answers.social_ninjo: He wants to read the bones without hearing Nagiko's questions echo underneath, but he accepted what the cards showed him and he will not break that debt.

answers.clan_relations: The Unicorn's pragmatism permits what the other clans call exile: Nergüi serves a Kitsuki investigator because the debt shown in the cards admitted no refusal, and the steppes will wait for a man who honors his obligations.

answers.most_learn: Tonbo Kazu — Tonbo Kazu taught Nergüi how to dress and carry himself fashionably and with appropriate status, because being foreign and anxious about how others saw him meant the education came at the cost of admitting he needed it.

answers.first_sight: Nergüi's Rokugani catches on certain words and he knows it, so he speaks slowly in order to speak clearly and reduce the extremity of Ujik inflection.

answers.stress: When pushed past his composure, Nergüi finds reasons the work cannot proceed today, deferring responsibility, missing deadlines, standing people up.

answers.relations:
Shika Shou (Deer) — Shika Shou arranged marriages for two of Nergüi's family members and speaks his dialect, which means she is one of the few people in Rokugan who will not make him repeat himself.
Iuchi Mitsumichi (Unicorn) — Mitsumichi warned him which words would offend the Tortoise in a bargaining room, knowledge bought by his own failed trades.

answers.parents_pov: Nagiko noticed that when Nergüi interprets the bones, he speaks to them in his own language, then translates each answer into Rokugani as though he does not trust the first reading until it has survived the passage between tongues.

answers.death: Nergüi read the bones already and knows the end is here, and accepts it.

bio:
Iuchi Nergüi — he/him — Yoriki to Nagiko

**Ujik Diviner** · Iuchi family, Ujik background · Sage · Void +1, Water +1 · Honor 40 · he/him
**Yoriki to Nagiko**

Name meaning: "no one" — traditionally given to a child to hide them from malicious spirits. Every Rokugani who asks his name is told *no one*, and has to decide whether that's insolence, a joke, or a foreigner mangling the language. The Hermit reversed generates itself in any scene, unstaged.
